enrichment method: immunoprecipitated (PTMScan® Acetyl-Lysine Motif [Ac-K] Kit #13416, Cell Signaling)
After desalting and treatment with trifluoroacetic, acetylated proteins were immunoprecipitated (PTMScan® Acetyl-Lysine Motif [Ac-K] Kit #13416, Cell Signaling).
fractionation method: After elution, peptides were resolubilized and separated via a reversed-phase column and analyzed using an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer.
instrument: analyzed using an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer.
labeling: AML cells (NOMO-1) were treated with RG2833 (5 µM) or with DMSO for 6 hours prior to preparing cellular extracts.
ptm: acetylated proteins were immunoprecipitated (PTMScan® Acetyl-Lysine Motif [Ac-K] Kit #13416, Cell Signaling).
reduction reagent: treating 10 mg of protein lysate with TCEP.
